package.name: stereo_handpose_estimation
package.description: Stereo hand-pose estimation: subscribes to per-camera MediaPipe landmark messages (handpose3d_msgs/HandLandmarks) and two camera_info topics, triangulates the 2D hand-landmark centroid across views for a robust 3D world position, places MediaPipe's metric hand_world_landmarks at it and publishes the result for RViz.
